dct_title_s: Libya Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Sep 2023
dct_description_sm: # Libya Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Sep 2023 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Libya Floods (Sep 2023) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Libya, Floods, 12 Sep 2023, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Libya, Floods, 12 Sep 2023, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Libya, Floods, 12 Sep 2023, v0.5** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2023), Validated with FirstLook Imagery Â© 2023 Maxar
